series.title: THE GENTLE ARMOR™
series.tagline: Soft on the surface. Strong underneath.
series.description: Five chapters about the battles no one sees. Each piece is armor made gentle: worn close, carried quietly.

chapters.title: The First Silence
chapters.quote: Some battles begin without a sound.
story: It starts small. A thought you do not say out loud. A morning you get through without telling anyone how heavy it felt.
Silence is not weakness. It is where most of us learn to be strong: alone, patient, and unseen.
This chapter is for the first quiet moment you chose to keep going. It was not dramatic. No one clapped. But it was the beginning of everything.
So we made something to wear for that moment: soft enough to hold you, strong enough to remind you that you already started.

highlights.label: The Feeling
highlights.text: Calm on the outside, a storm held gently within.

highlights.label: The Fabric
highlights.text: Heavyweight, brushed soft. Built to feel like a held breath.

chapters.title: Held Together
chapters.summary: On the strength found in staying whole.
chapters.quote: Being whole is not the absence of cracks.
story: Some days the only thing you do is hold yourself together. No one sees the effort. It looks like an ordinary morning.
Strength is not always loud or visible. Often it is the quiet decision to stay in one piece when everything asks you to come apart.
This chapter honours that decision. We made it with seams that stay close and a fit that holds you, so you can carry the day without breaking.

chapters.title: Thread by Thread
chapters.summary: Healing happens slowly, one stitch at a time.
chapters.quote: Healing is slow, and slow is still moving.
story: Nobody heals all at once. Recovery happens in small, almost invisible movements, like a seam closing one stitch at a time.
Some days you will move forward. Some days you will only stay still. Both count, because both keep the thread from breaking.
This chapter is for the patient part of every battle: careful hands, small progress, and the quiet belief that you are being mended.

chapters.title: The Weight You Carry
chapters.summary: What we hold, we learn to wear lightly.
chapters.quote: What we carry becomes part of how we stand.
story: Everyone carries something no one else can see: a worry, a memory, a responsibility that never quite sets down.
The weight does not disappear. We learn to carry it differently, to balance it, to let it become part of how we stand.
This chapter is about carrying it lightly. We designed it to rest on the shoulders gently, so strength never has to feel heavy.

chapters.title: Still Standing
chapters.summary: The quiet victory of simply continuing.
chapters.quote: Some victories are just a morning you did not give up on.
story: At the end of every long battle there is rarely a moment of triumph. There is only the next morning, and you are still here.
That is its own kind of victory: quiet, unannounced and entirely yours.
This chapter closes the series with a simple truth. You kept going. You are still standing, and that is enough.

products.name: THE FIRST SILENCE HOODIE
products.description: A heavyweight hoodie made for the days you carry more than you say. Soft inside, structured outside: gentle armor you can wear anywhere.
